zh: 手机的「更多」和「工具」在浮窗内展开，保持顶栏与输入栏高度，限制在可视屏幕内，点击外侧或关闭按钮即可收起。版本升级保留固定设置入口与原有主题配置。
en: Phone conversation actions and input tools open in floating windows within the visual viewport, preserving header and composer height. Dismiss outside or with the close button. Upgrades retain the stable settings namespace and existing theme preferences.
